###############
### Bigrams ###
###############

```{r}
bigrams <- DTS_fulltext |> 
  unnest_tokens(bigram, sentence, token="ngrams", n=2)

bigrams
```

```{r}
data(stop_words)

bigrams |> 
  filter(!is.na(bigram)) |> 
  separate(bigram, c("word1", "word2"), sep = " ") |> 
  filter(!word1 %in% stop_words$word) |> 
  filter(!word2 %in% stop_words$word) |> 
  count(word1, word2)
```

```{r}
bigram_filtered <- bigrams |> 
  filter(!is.na(bigram)) |> 
  separate(bigram, c("word1", "word2"), sep = " ") |> 
  filter(!word1 %in% stop_words$word) |> 
  filter(!word2 %in% stop_words$word) |> 
  count(word1, word2, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
deaf_bigram <- bigram_filtered |> 
  filter(grepl("deaf", word1, ignore.case = TRUE) | grepl("deaf", word2, ignore.case = TRUE))
```
